title: Single Parameter Name
instructions: In a lambda with a single parameter, you can refer to that parameter as _____.
prompt: In a lambda with a single parameter, you can refer to that parameter as _____.
explanation: When a lambda has exactly one parameter, Kotlin provides the automatic name `it` so you do not have to declare a parameter name. For example, `{ it * 2 }` is the same as `{ x -> x * 2 }`.
